disposition_reason: Table 1 prints mean, SD and range for Fe, Pb and Cu, and non-detection for Cd, in 30 retail baby formula samples.

study.market: retail outlets, Bani Waleed City, Libya
study.method: HNO3/HClO4 acid digestion after reconstitution and 0.45 µm filtration; flame AAS (Varian AA240)
study.lod_text: Cd 0.01 mg/kg; not stated for Pb, Fe, Cu
study.qa: Calibration standards and blanks only; no CRM or recovery reported

findings.group: retail baby formula, Bani Waleed City, Q1 2023
findings.notes: Paper says powdered formulas were reconstituted (10 g in 100 mL) and ready-to-feed formulas weighed directly, but does not say how many of the 30 samples were each type; label follows the dominant powder description. Milk base (cow or soy) not stated. Basis as sold. Flame AAS LOD stated only for Cd (0.01 mg/kg).
